verdict.rationale: stagewise's own docs describe Skills as SKILL.md files that give the agent structured instructions for specific tasks and project-specific workflows. These skills can be invoked explicitly with slash commands, which directly delivers custom skills for specialized tasks. missing for 10: details on authoring, file location and format for custom SKILL.md files, and independent or hands-on corroboration that custom skills work as described.

support.subject: As a developer, I can equip the agent with custom skills to perform specialized tasks

citations.quote: Skills are SKILL.md files that give the agent structured instructions for specific tasks. They teach the agent project-specific patterns, workflows, and constraints.
Invoke skills explicitly with slash commands. Type / in the chat to see available commands from your skills and plugins.
